name: Ledger writer and delivery MVP (ADR-055 P1/P2)
goal: Implement ADR-055 phases P1-P2: anchor the ceremony ledger in a sparse, gitignored detached worktree (.synth/anchor) advanced by update-ref CAS with a lock and a dirty-ledger pre-check; route lifecycle ceremonies through the writer so each ceremony is one commit on the canonical branch; make doctor fail on uncommitted ledger, stale/missing anchor and ledger-ahead-of-main, with --fix performing worktree prune + re-add; add expedition deliver (push branch/publish PR, record EXPEDITION_DELIVERED) and expedition seal --merge-commit (verify the delivered tip is an ancestor of the merge commit, record EXPEDITION_INTEGRATED), plus the abandonment handoff block and deliveryPending marker.

metadata.refinementNote: E5 consumes E1 staging correctness and E4 declared branch bindings
